[strategy/workshops/sessions/roadmap-planning/README.md#workshop-type-overview]

## Workshop Type Overview

Roadmap planning workshops help organizations:

- Define strategic technology direction
- Align business and technology timelines
- Prioritize initiatives and investments
- Create actionable implementation plans
- Establish milestone and success criteria

## Common Outputs

- Technology roadmaps
- Business capability roadmaps
- Investment prioritization matrices
- Implementation timelines
- Risk and dependency analyses

## Usage Guidelines

When creating a new roadmap planning workshop session:

1. Create a folder with format: `[Session-Name]-[MM-DD-YYYY]/`
2. Include `inputs/` and `outputs/` subfolders
3. Add a session-specific README.md
4. Update this file to list the new session
